ideas.title: Deep PC cleanup
ideas.notes: Scan/preview first; safe cleanup; quarantine/reversible where practical; protect projects/user data; no blind registry cleaner.

ideas.title: Operator security / antivirus control center
ideas.notes: Integrate Windows Defender first: status, scans, threat history, quarantine, signatures, firewall, persistence inventory.

ideas.title: Deep-Freeze-style healthy baseline / restore
ideas.notes: Start with last-known-good snapshots, restore points, manifests, integrity baseline and rollback. Do not start with a kernel disk filter.

ideas.title: Voice-driven INVENTHOR control
ideas.notes: Voice understanding stays in INVENTHOR; Operator receives structured capabilities/tasks.

ideas.title: Inventhor Operator logo and final visual identity
ideas.notes: Current logo not accepted. Defer branding and final desktop visual polish until unattended runtime is verified.

ideas.title: Full PC control center
ideas.notes: Performance, cleanup, processes, services, storage, network, startup, software updates, desktop control and power/system.

ideas.title: INVENTHOR Family personalized tutoring / Aile Eğitim Asistanı
ideas.notes: Owner proposal 2026-10-16: adult foreign-language practice, child-specific English/German, mathematics/science/school subjects, adaptive micro-lessons, tests, spaced review, guardian-governed child profiles and private per-learner progress. Main owns routing and authorization; extend existing Language/Memory domains with optional subject skill packs. No duplicate brain, no advertising or public learner data. Draft idea, not canonical live Work Item or deployed feature. Owner additional requirements: strong bidirectional German/Turkish/English translation, instant opt-in chat translation, and opt-in Viktorija-inspired word marking, tap details, fill-in-word and fill-in-letters inside family chat; Main remains authenticated host and no duplicate Viktorija app. Owner clarification 2026-10-17: primary product goal is TEACHING; translation and Viktorija-inspired chat tools are optional learning aids, not the outcome. Owner addition 2026-10-17: optional music teaching and vocal coach, guided pitch/rhythm/voice practice, virtual instruments, supportive DE/EN pronunciation activities; permissions, child vocal comfort and no default recording required.
ideas.acceptance_criterion: Learner independently demonstrates understanding on new examples and later review; translation or revealing an answer never counts as mastery.
